objective: Implement deterministic fail-closed daily-loss and latched circuit-breaker admission control after P16-E, using explicit governed loss ceilings and caller-supplied trading-day identity without timezone assumptions.
scope: Require explicit trading_day_id supplied by the caller
Compute daily loss in basis points from explicit day-start equity and current equity using conservative ceiling rounding
Treat current equity above day-start equity as zero daily loss
Trip the circuit breaker when daily loss reaches or exceeds an explicit governed ceiling
Preserve an already-tripped circuit breaker as latched until an external governed reset creates a new clear state
Emit deterministic PRETRADE_F_ELIGIBLE or VETO decisions
out_of_scope: Deriving local day boundaries or timezone assumptions
Broker/exchange order creation, routing or execution
tests: Positive/flat PnL yields zero daily loss
Loss equal to ceiling trips circuit
Invalid or non-positive equity fails closed
No reset, G8, position-close or execution authority is emitted
P16-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P16-F module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P16-E remains canonical complete and P16-G remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Daily-loss and latched circuit-breaker admission control implemented
No implicit day boundary or production limit defaults
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
